Family app · working prototype

Fifty years of BISC, one front door.

A phone app for BISC parents and guardians, on top of Engage, the Junior Portal and the newsletter. Five things done well, and one only a fifty-year-old school can do: the Archive.

  1. 1Today. Each child's day, house points, absences.
  2. 2Feed. Targeted notices and consented albums.
  3. 3Calendar. Terms, mocks and public holidays.
  4. 4The Archive. Volume 51 and fifty on the shelf.
  5. 5Progress and Bus 12. Grades, live tracking.

Real: leadership names, the 1976 founding in Zamalek, the Beverly Hills address, the four houses, the main phone, info@ and admissions@ and platforms. Sample: families, teachers, Bus 12, grades, house points and 2026–2027 dates. Campus and school-life photographs and portraits are illustrative stand-ins. Demo clock: Thursday 12 November 2026.
